summary: Architectural implementation plan for optimizing the 3D nocturnal portfolio world for mobile performance while preserving desktop visual fidelity, interactive exhibits, controls, and nocturnal sci-fi identity. Covers adaptive High/Medium/Low quality tiers with Pause menu override, dynamic point-light consolidation with emissive glow decals, instanced geometry batching, smart render-loop lifecycle throttling/pausing, GPU texture scaling and disposal, and optional dev-only diagnostics.
